## Result and status
Complete annular counterexample candidate for Function Theory Problem 7.42 (2307042 / AMR-022-7042, rank 857), accepted unchanged by two independent AI mathematical reviews. The original author freeze and both review archives are preserved byte-for-byte. No correction patch was required.

For D={1<|z|<e}, a=sqrt(e), and the minimal Martin kernel at the inner-boundary point -1 normalized at a, K<H_a throughout a punctured neighborhood of a. This excludes equality throughout every nontrivial Green line issuing from a. Equality at a remains; isolated contact farther away is outside the claim. The direct analytic argument verifies the Green/Martin construction, minimality, and a uniform all-direction competitor gap. Finite sampling and hashing are not mathematical proofs.

This remains an unrefereed candidate. Historical novelty, priority, current worldwide status, human peer review, and formal proof-assistant certification are not asserted. Primary question: Hayman–Lingham, Research Problems in Function Theory (New Edition), arXiv:1809.07200v2, Problem 7.42 and Update 7.42, printed pp. 173–174: https://arxiv.org/abs/1809.07200v2 .

## Scope
- Add 40 files under unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/2307042/.
- Change only this queue row’s Status to claimed_solved, Turns to 1/5, and qualified Findings. Every other queue byte is preserved.
- Include authored proof, both independent audits and acceptances, three immutable safe archives, bounded public verification metadata, and external integrity-only helpers.
- Exclude copied third-party documents, raw source extracts, dataset contents, private sources, and private coordination material.
- Historical pending-review/no-publication labels within immutable packets are retained as historical records; the wrapper and separate acceptances state the later status.

## Verification
- Head: 5820e9784dbcfeda0acabaa435cb38cf6a4576df.
- Read back all 41 changed files at that exact commit: all 631,400 bytes match the prepared files, with matching Git blob identities.
- Exact remote path set: 40 additions and one modified queue file; one commit over the pinned main base.
- All 25 members across the three remotely retrieved archives match their original bytes; six isolated normal/optimized remote integrity replays pass.
- First audit: 58 integrity cases passed after a disclosed disposable-fixture adaptation. The unchanged harness initially stopped because copytree preserved read-only modes in a mutation fixture; only the private replay copy used writable temporary byte copies. No verifier or published artifact was changed.
- Second review: six positive, nineteen negative, and three supporting author checks reproduced the saved replay byte-for-byte; all thirteen final-review checks were replayed successfully.
- Integrity checks establish file identity only. No repository-wide suite was run. At 2026-10-06 12:17 UTC, the exact head has zero commit statuses, zero check runs, and zero workflow runs; this is not a CI pass. Required branch-protection configuration could not be inspected because the integration returned HTTP 403. The branch-rules route is unsupported by this connector.

See [the package README](https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/blob/5820e9784dbcfeda0acabaa435cb38cf6a4576df/unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/2307042/README.md), [proof](https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/blob/5820e9784dbcfeda0acabaa435cb38cf6a4576df/unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/2307042/author/PROOF.md), and [publication validation](https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/blob/5820e9784dbcfeda0acabaa435cb38cf6a4576df/unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/2307042/PUBLICATION_VALIDATION.json).

Draft only; no merge, release, DOI, or external outreach.
